findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_email_domain_security" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_domain_security, score_it_health_check, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, get_managed_services_pricing_catalogue · Private data: check_email_domain_security, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, request_tier1_contact · Public sink: check_email_domain_security, score_it_health_check, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, get_managed_services_pricing_catalogue, request_tier1_contact · Destructive: get_tier1_resource.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_domain_security, score_it_health_check, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, get_managed_services_pricing_catalogue · Private data: check_email_domain_security, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, request_tier1_contact · Public sink: check_email_domain_security, score_it_health_check, get_tier1_recommendations, get_tier1_resource, get_managed_services_pricing_catalogue, request_tier1_contact · Destructive: get_tier1_resource

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
